Kill [[Inquisitor Lovisa]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
Must have access to [[Lion's Arch Keep]], see [[:File:War in Kryta flow chart.png|flowchart]] for details.

===Objectives===
* Kill [[Inquisitor Lovisa]] in [[Watchtower Coast (War in Kryta)|Watchtower Coast]]
* *BONUS* Kill Inquisitor Lovisa in [[Hard Mode]]
* See [[Princess Salma]] for your reward

===Reward===
* 5,000 [[Experience]]
* 1000 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 20 [[War Supplies]]
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 10 War Supplies

==Walkthrough==
Carefully clear the surrounding groups before engaging Lovisa's. Pull her group out of range of the [[Missing Child|Missing Children's]] [[Adoration]]. It is possible to lure all other [[White Mantle]] units away from Lovisa.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Wanted by the Shining Blade
:''"[[Inquisitor Lovisa]] has absconded with children from Krytan farms and villages.  Allies of Kryta can claim a royal bounty by slaying Lovisa in Watchtower Coast and rescuing the children before she can warp their impressionable minds and indoctrinate them in the ways of the Unseen Ones."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'll do whatever I can to help restore order to Kryta.
| decline = War! What is it good for?
| ask = Think of the children! Go slay Inquisitor Lovisa in Watchtower Coast and rescue the abducted children before she can warp their minds!
}}

;Princess Salma
:''"Thank you [Character Name], your efforts bring us one step closer to a unified nation."''

==Notes==
* Lovisa refers to the spell [[Adoration]] when she tells the Missing Children to ''"give me your strength"''.

* If [[The Undead Hordes]] is active, waves of undead will engage the Mantle on the northeast route from [[Beetletun]] towards the beach.

{{Anomaly|Lovisa might not spawn if [[Riverside Assassination]] is active for one or more party members.}}

{{bug|Players who started the three required [[Wanted by the Shining Blade|''Wanted'' quests]] before the [[Feedback:Game_updates/20101119|19 November 2010 update]] might be forced to take [[The War in Kryta|the official umbrella quest]], which is optional otherwise. If you are unable to move on to [[Riverside Assassination]], speak to [[Murro]] in Lion's Arch and add ''The War in Kryta'' to your quest log.}}
 
{{bug|If a [[White Mantle Ritualist (ritualist)|White Mantle Ritualist]] appears with Lovisa, the spirits it summons will be allied with you but you do not receive any benefits from them, nor can you attack them.}}

{{bug|This quest was available again for some [[characters]], after completion of the first three [[Hearts of the North]] missions.}}
